name: Sales
notes: Seed configuration for the first board, not product code. The seven stage names are the
stakeholder's own columns; the core tables in workers-bus/migrations/0113_pipeline_board_core.sql
know nothing about them. M3 turns pipelines and stages user-editable by writing these same rows,
so nothing here has to be unpicked first.
Card slot bindings follow the PO decisions recorded on IRO-209: D4 value, D5 services, D6
identifiers. There is no activity-counter source anywhere in the system yet (ELEC-158), so no
counter slot is declared and every card reports an empty counters list rather than a fake one.
